title: Transformer only applied to text tasks
description: The paper only evaluates the Transformer on machine translation and constituency parsing. The authors explicitly plan to extend it to input and output modalities other than text.
canonical_description: model only applied to text modalities with plans to extend to other modalities

evidence.quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
